div.div: Rules (M3-DESIGN §0, §4). Import direction: media.service and private files never import feed; only router.py reads feed.service (D30, tests/test_architecture.py). Blur is applied once on the server; no unblurred copy is kept (D33, Q31). Private bucket + signed GET URLs: signing time floored to 30 min, valid 60 min (D34). Uploader / doer removal deletes the objects after commit; admin removal moves them to held/ so every issued URL returns 404 at once; restore uses a new version. Reports never change a photo, deed, verification, counts or points (D42).
